title: Wso2am: Netty, an asynchronous, event-driven network application framework, has a vulnerability in versions up to and…
description: A security vulnerability exists in the wso2am package due to an issue in Netty, an asynchronous, event-driven network application framework. The vulnerability affects versions up to and including 4.4.0-r1. It has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.5 and impacts availability without affecting confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in version 4.4.0-r1.
